doi_enrichment_followup.scope: 41 existing metadata-only records; no new source reads or DOI assignments.
workflow: Obtain authorized original post content or an attributable capture and inspect its actual outbound links.
Resolve the linked work against publisher or DOI metadata; verify the relationship to this post, title and authors before assigning a primary DOI.
Preserve multiple cited works separately; do not substitute thematically similar papers or infer a primary work when none is established.
Record link origin and evidence locator, verification depth and date. Identity verification is not an abstract or full-text read.
Use NOT_APPLICABLE only after inspection establishes that no paper association applies. Unread records remain NOT_YET_CHECKED.
Skip unchanged failed searches unless new attributable material or a new lead is available; prioritize eligible sources with resolvable identity.
doi_enrichment_followup.restrictions: Existing BLOCKED statuses, source checkpoint, admission counters, privacy, rights, evidence, live-access and publication safeguards are preserved.
